facts.text: お嬢様's own room: 真里亜 guides a visitor to it, and the three of them once celebrated there.
The house can lend rooms to the club for a training camp, and 真里亜 lays the guests' futons while they bathe.
She makes the tea herself and names it (Darjeeling, autumnal).
She prepares food and baths through 'others' of the house, so there is household staff beyond her; none is named.
The record is silent: it never shows where 真里亜 sleeps or what is in it. LIBERTY: for the two-person world she has a plain maid's room in the house, with nothing in it described.
The house has a master and a mistress, spoken of only as 「ご主人様と奥様」 and 「旦那様と奥方様」; unnamed, never present in a beat, no detail.
Relatives of the mistress stay overnight at times.

week.text: A school shop shift three days a week at the entrance; she helps with the displays and serves.
week.note: three days a week is 一悟's narration (01_01:3496), kept as a fact of the world, not as a line of hers

week.text: Outside lessons and shifts she is with お嬢様, serving her.
Before the first bell she watches the time and tells the club.
In the club room she makes tea for the club.
She carries Cerberus's meals to the student council room.
She asks to be woken if anything happens at night.
When お嬢様 is unwell she stays with her and sends word to the school.

care_of_momoka.text: She says the doctor found fatigue behind a cold, and that the fever has gone down.
She says お嬢様 hides being unwell until the last moment and says 'I am fine'.
She says trips and outings with friends were given up for お嬢様's health.
